about_the_game:
🛡️ RAIDBOUND

A Tactical Viking Auto-Battler with Roguelite Worker Placement

In Raidbound, you lead a clan of fearless Vikings through a mythic gauntlet of combat, sacrifice, and divine favor. This is no idle expedition—each decision shapes the fate of your warband.

Recruit your warriors from the Tavern, train them in the ways of battle, and prepare them for war. Infuse them with ancient runes, forge legendary weapons, or sacrifice them to strengthen the clan. Once your energy for the year is spent, you must Raid—battling another player’s clan in asynchronous auto-combat.

Between battles, travel across a living map of strategic Nodes. Each offers a different boon—or risk. The road to glory is yours to choose.

⚔️ Vikings & Combat

  • Each Viking joins your clan with a unique ability and one of four roles:
    Raider, Warden, Berserker, or Skirmisher.
    Roles create synergies—like Wardens granting bonus armor when grouped.

  • You can equip up to 4 abilities per Viking, unlocked by infusing them with Runes.
    Combat is fully automated, but strategic: Vikings attack based on speed, targeting (frontline, backline, or random), and ability loadout.

  • Lose a Raid, and you lose a life. When you’re out—your run ends.

🧠 HERO PASSIVES & ABILITY SYNERGIES

  • Every run, choose from a variety of hero powers that shape your overall strategy.

  • Passives range from tank-saving effects to formation-breaking wildcards.

  • Stack buffs, status effects, and rune enhancements to create emergent combos across your Vikings.

  • Replay value comes from mixing heroes, drafting new powers, and discovering devastating synergy chains.

🪓 RUNE-ENHANCED CREW SYSTEM

  • Earn and equip powerful Runes to augment your Vikings with effects like:

    • Burn, poison, bleed, freeze, haste, armor, and more.

  • Equipment is consumable power boosts.

  • Build run-specific loadouts to adapt to enemy types and draft RNG.

🔁 ROGUELITE PROGRESSION LOOP

  • Fight through a series of PvE and PvP rounds, each more intense than the last.

  • Losing a PvP battle costs lives — but clever planning ensures you stay in the fight.

  • Each victory earns rewards and choices that evolve your strategy for the next encounter.

  • Runs end when all Vikings fall… or you become the top Jarl.

🗺️ CHOOSE YOUR PATH: KEY NODES

  • Sparring Pit – Face rival clans to earn gold and glory.

  • Hunting Grounds – Hunt prey to gather rations and empower future recruits.

  • Gold Mine – Mine ore safely… or risk it all for a greater haul.

  • Blacksmith – Forge weapons and armor to power up your entire warband.

  • Odin’s Trial – Send one Viking to receive a divine gift.

  • Ritual Site – Sacrifice a Viking; their strength flows into the rest of your clan.

  • Runesmith – Choose one of three powerful runes to permanently enhance a Viking.

  • Gambler’s Den – Risk any resource—gold, rations, even lives—for a chance at glory.

  • Voyage (Post-Demo) – Set sail to earn powerful relics, if you can brave the sea.

  • Thor’s Blessing – Gain extra energy to extend your journey.

  • Odin's Gift – Gain 2 lives when you are on your last life. Only usable once.

  • Mystic – Revisit previously used nodes for greater flexibility.

⚖️ Dishonor & Rerolls

  • When the Gods offer choices, you may not always agree.
    Spend glory to reroll—but each reroll increases Dishonor, making future choices riskier and more expensive.

🛠️ KEY FEATURES

  • 🧩 Deep tactical auto-battler with formation and cooldown-focused combat

  • 🔥 Strategic draft system and hero-defining passive powers

  • 🪄 Merge and manipulate Runes for customizable Viking effects

  • 🌌 Unique Viking classes and abilities with synergy-driven gameplay

  • ⚔️ Mix of PvE encounters and async PvP battles with ranked opponents

  • 🛡 No microtransactions – a fully premium, progression-based experience

Will your clan survive the chaos? Or will your saga be lost in the mist? Prepare your warband. Forge your legacy. Become… Raidbound.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GT 630 (2 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ HD 6670 (2 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-3570 (quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 650 (2 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ HD 7750 (2 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Raidbound is a Viking-themed auto-battler with a worker placement style system. Recruit warriors, forge gear, sacrifice for power, and raid rival clans. Choose your path, build your warband, and earn glory across a mythic map of tactical choices.
